decision: ACCEPT candidate D (army destination safety + re-decision of moving armies whose destination turned unsafe or invalid)

rejected.D2: route safety added nothing over D (seed11 identical; seed23 escortless arrivals 0->3, wartime disband 57->61)
rejected.P: stacking penalty on destinations: orders 222->74 (seed11), 196->73 (seed23) vs D, but army-loss effect inconsistent across placebo bands (one seed23 world 3->10) and +1 critical month in two worlds
rejected.E: army may exceed the monthly alloy budget cap: in the target case the army failed on minerals instead, the alloy reservation lapsed and the catastrophe came the same month; root cause is an economic threshold (separate phase decision)

criteria.1 proven army/escort defect solved: 96H.9 sends armies into own colonies held by visible hostile fleets (22 of 39 non-attack army hulls lost; seed11 pl1 sys20: 13 orders, 12 armies dead on arrival) and never re-decides a moving army (3 in-transit deaths); fixtures month228 and month173 reproduce both and 96H.10 avoids them
criteria.2 fewer unnecessary army losses: army hulls lost in space combat: seed11 5x240 22->12, seed23 16->13, 8x120 10->9; placebo bands: median losses lower or equal in 7/7 triggered worlds (seed11 pl1 17->3)
criteria.3 successful 96H.9 invasions intact: clean conquests 13=13 / 1=1 / 1=1, colony conquests 19=19 / 9=9 / 5=5; 96H.9 month-66 and month-79 escorted clean captures unchanged (tests); same army orders on the month-79 fixture
criteria.4 navy not passivated: no fleet decision changed; army orders seed11 224->222, seed23 137->196 (surviving armies continue the pre-existing defence ping-pong)
criteria.6 no new economic crisis: critical empire-months 23=23 / 15=15 / 16=16; trade 8.8=8.8 / 143.8->144.2 / 392=392; ships/power differences are chaotic (bands overlap, medians both directions)
criteria.7 Save8/RNG: no new Save field, no RNG; seeds 11/23/42/99/404/7/123 identical month by month over 120 months
criteria.8 diplomacy/federation/war: joint-operation and delivery fleets never re-tasked; player armies untouched; economy/combat/diplomacy bytes unchanged
criteria.10 player experience: AI no longer feeds unarmed armies one by one into a pirate- or enemy-held orbit; fewer wasted army purchases (41->36, 37->34)

sorun_B: not fixed: catastrophes come from attackers that cannot afford an army (monthly alloy cap, minerals) and from the last-hop-only truce rule; both outside this phase (economic threshold / engine rule)
